children: JAN3 said its newly launched exchange infrastructure, Indra, was hit by a denial-of-service attack, prompting the team to temporarily disable forward swaps while it investigates. According to ChainCatcher, swaps already in progress may be delayed.
Indra was developed by JAN3 to replace Boltz in Aqua and allow users to move bitcoin between Lightning and Liquid, but Liquid peg-in operations remain restricted.

title: JAN3 Temporarily Disables Indra Forward Swaps After Denial-Of-Service Attack
